name: Ghost & Joker -Kimi no Tame ni Dekirukoto-
original_name: ゴースト＆ジョーカー -君の為に出来ること-
source: One day you wake up as a ghost… "Joker", a girl dressed in black, a "Grim reaper," says you "Must help those who are living", if you want to regain your missing body and lost memory. You are approaching extinction, mysteries are arising everywhere, and the living are suffering... Can you resurrect yourself and reach the truth of this story?
translation: 有一天，你醒来时变成了鬼……“小丑”，一个黑衣女孩，一个“死神”，对你说，如果你想找回失踪的身体和失去的记忆，“必须帮助那些活着的人”。你濒临灭绝，谜团无处不在，生者受苦……你能复活自己并了解这个故事的真相吗？
